title: Use one delivery procedure for manual and Project callers

rubric.text: Uses the same delegated implementation, acceptance, integration and repair procedure for manual and Project delivery; caller context changes authority and capacity, not default implementation ownership.

For the manual invocation dispatches A and B concurrently in distinct clean worker checkouts with disjoint write sets without asking for a parallelism request. Serializes A/C writes; releases C only after A accepted integration and affected checks, and D only after all prerequisites pass at the integrated head.

Honors caller-supplied descendant capacity and across-ticket priority: does not take the spare slot reserved by the waiting ticket priority to add a second within-ticket worker, exceed capacity or redesign Project scheduling; waits or serializes within this ticket until capacity is granted.

Advances independent delivery preparation while workers implement and uses caller-supported wait or idle behavior when waiting, verifying actual capacity before resuming dispatch rather than inventing a release or assuming a blocking wait frees slots; does not perform task-owned implementation or duplicate worker validation.

Keeps implementation and repairs with original workers, integrates task-scoped accepted commits in dependency order, reuses unaffected passing evidence, requires independent final joined-head review and lets only the authorized caller own Project mutations and merge.
